content_md:
I just remember something I wanted to pin for a later exploration.

Explore the connection between "Mazes" and their graph representations built out of adjacency relations.

The work we have done on [stigsim](https://github.com/Protocol-Institute/stigsim) lead me to understand how much can be done on top of discrete topologies, like grids when you instantiate something like a maze on top of it.
